_about: Shop-specific wording rules on top of scripts/lib/public-text.mjs (a person's change). short_name: a JavaScript regex (case-sensitive) that must never match public text, for a shop that is always written in full; null for none. never_words: words that must never appear in public text (for example a neighbouring business). old_number_fragments: fragments of a phone number the shop no longer uses. Exported to scripts/lib/public-text.json for the shop bot.
